objective.title: Qualify managed real and complex elementary and positive Gamma functions

declared.summary: Qualify an explicit managed BCL provider for bounded real sin/cos/exp/log, positive-real Lanczos Gamma and complex principal sin/cos/exp/log in Math scientific preview.3. Recover one compiled missing-API RED and pass 79 new GREEN, 158 retained exact tests and four Math regressions. Verify a real local archive by two eight-probe NuGet-only clients with matching SHA-256. Close C02-T1 only; Gamma poles, complex Gamma, alternate branches and public release remain unqualified.
declared.value: Expose useful, reusable managed real/complex special functions through a provider-neutral contract with typed finite domains, radian convention, explicit backend identity and no unsupported error-bound or automatic MathNet-fallback claims.
debtChanges: Use one explicit managed BCL backend and a provider interface; prior MathNet 5.0 smoke supports EXT-NUMERIC but is not imported or silently used as fallback.
Observe a genuinely compiled missing-public-facade/provider RED before staging real and complex implementations.
Admit real sin/cos/exp/log on finite bounded domains and Lanczos Gamma only for positive real x in [0.5,20], without a precision theorem.
Admit finite complex principal Sin/Cos/Exp/Log with separate component limits; refuse complex Gamma, invalid log domain, and unknown operations.
Use radians only in T1, typed nonpartial numeric refusals, caller range controls and runtime provider/rule observations.
Recover the compiled RED, pass 79 independent GREEN and 158 retained C01 exact tests, and four relevant Math regressions.
Pack real local net10 scientific preview.3 and compare actual SHA/byte receipts from independent special-function and retained exact eight-probe NuGet clients.
Close only C02 T1 R/G/V and T1; defer C02 T2 branch/pole/angle/error boundaries, M6-W02/M6 completion and stable/public publication.
declared.nextAction: After durable RS090 success, prepare M6-W02-C02-T2 to qualify Gamma poles, complex logarithm branches, angle conventions and overflow/underflow boundaries; keep C02, W02 and M6 open.
